features.name: PX4-style cascaded drone controller
features.notes: Velocity→attitude→rate→motor cascade with gimbal and zoom control

features.name: Multi-agent delay/staleness/dropout simulation
features.notes: Ringbuffer-based with timestamp guarantees. Fixed calling contract: advance/query split ensures idempotent multi-call per step. Stage order: staleness→latency→FOL→dropout. (2026-03-23)

features.name: Two-layer collision avoidance (CPA + deploy filter)
features.notes: Training-time soft penalty + deployment-time hard filter

features.name: Multi-camera multi-target triangulation with covariance
features.notes: Linear least-squares with condition number check

features.name: GPU-accelerated 2D bbox extraction with occlusion
features.notes: Warp raycasting for occlusion detection. Detector replicator submodule added: Student's t noise with size-dependent scale, dual output (GT→rewards, replicated→obs). (2026-04-08)

features.name: Calibrated detector noise replicator (YOLO sim-to-real)
features.notes: Ticket-009: Student's t noise with calibrated params from offline YOLO calibration. Architecture in bbox_raycaster_v2/detector_replicator.py. Dual bbox output wired to delay system. Teleop validation showed uniform noise is exaggerated — needs confidence-conditioned noise (ticket-010). Noise model refit pending. (2026-04-08)

features.name: Curriculum-driven initial state randomization
features.notes: Cylinder-based placement with curriculum height/orientation/zoom. Tuned for ma5-parity at progress=0 (2026-03-20)

features.name: Debug visualization (frustums, ellipsoids, detection)
features.notes: Camera frustums, LOS indicators, covariance ellipsoids

features.name: Curriculum learning system
features.notes: Redesigned: decoupled agent velocity ramp (0-40k, 3→10m/s) from target motion (40k-120k). Observability phases pushed after target mastery (noise 120k, delay 140k+). Anti-forgetting: tau_zoom/max_lin_vel wide-range randomization. Backlog: per-agent noise/dropout/max_lin_vel (2026-03-24)

features.name: Full environment integration and training
features.notes: Obs: 30D ego (pos, vel, rpy, ang_vel_b, lin_acc_b, gimbal joints, ray_dir_w, combined_ang_vel_w, bbox_aoi, zoom, bbox) + 16D*(N-1) inter-agent [+6D tri]. ray_w fixed: bbox-based (camera→target) not gimbal pointing (2026-03-27)

features.name: Experiment registry, training runners, and evaluation pipeline
features.notes: 42 experiments (A1/A3/A4/A5/A6/A7/baselines/sweeps), 4 suites, metric tracker with CBF metrics, greedy baseline with gimbal tracking. Ported from iris_ma5, dropped MLP path. (2026-03-23)

features.name: Oscillation-aware parallel controller auto-tuning
features.notes: Real DroneController in tuner, oscillation metrics (damping/ZC/amplitude/freq), multi-speed tests (5+10 m/s at 100Hz), step response PDF plotter, TuningScoreWeights, gain coupling in search, --aero-level flag. Spawned ticket-004 (drag FF) and ticket-006 (DR integration). (2026-04-06)

features.name: PX4 SITL response matching via gain sweep
features.notes: sysid_replicator.py: loads PX4 SITL CSVs, resamples 125→100 Hz, scores DroneController gain candidates via timeseries MSE (vel 60%/att 25%/rate 15%). 4 tests (hover, vel_5, impulse, yaw). 3-way PDF overlay (PX4-matched vs PX4 SITL vs current). Exports PX4_MATCHED_CONTROLLER_CFG. vel_5 settling matched to 0.7%. (2026-04-06)

features.name: DomainRandomizer wiring into env _reset_idx
features.notes: Integrated: DomainRandomizer instantiated in __init__, randomize_all() called in _reset_idx, curriculum-gated by progress_dynamics (180k-200k). Camera FOV→intrinsic scale flows to bbox raycaster + delay system. Physics mass/inertia written to sim assets (controller keeps nominal mass for model mismatch). Gimbal offsets added to joint position targets. Gimbal dynamics (stiffness/damping) applied to actuators. Mount offset enabled. (2026-04-06)
